items.source:
Notification of context close phase for auto-stopping components
before destruction.
items.translation: 在销毁之前，为自动停止组件通知上下文关闭阶段。

items.source: Notification of context pause for auto-stopping components.
items.translation: 自动停止组件的上下文暂停通知。

items.source: Notification of context refresh for auto-starting components.
items.translation: 自动启动组件的上下文刷新通知。

items.source:
Notification of context restart for auto-stopping and subsequently
auto-starting components.
items.translation: Context 自动停止并随后自动启动组件时的上下文重启通知。

items.source: Strategy interface for processing Lifecycle beans within the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 用于在 ApplicationContext 中处理生命周期 Bean 的策略接口。
